description: This file provides a function to format generated source code modules by saving the source to a temporary file, invoking an external formatter via spawn process, and reading back the formatted output. It handles platform-specific differences and error scenarios.

methods.name: formatGeneratedModule
methods.description: Formats a generated source code module by writing it to a temporary file, invoking an external formatter (oxfmt), and then reading the formatted code back. Handles platform-specific command invocation and error propagation.
